sources.finding: The official final gamebook records New England's 45-17 final, a 3,600-second regulation game, both inactive lists, starters and substitutes, and the printed injury sequence. Las Vegas DT Tonka Hemingway was questionable to return at the start of Q2 and later ruled out. New England CB Charles Woods was questionable and subsequently returned; ED Dre'Mont Jones was questionable with no printed return; DT Cory Durden was questionable and explicitly returned. Will Campbell and TreVeyon Henderson were ruled out with no return.

The Raiders' October 9 final injury report lists Jalen Nailor (concussion), Dont'e Thornton Jr. (hamstring; IR-returned to practice) and Trey Zuhn III (knee) as Out. Ashton Jeanty was Questionable and the other listed Raiders carried no final game status.
The Raiders' official roster page identifies Tonka Hemingway as a Las Vegas defensive tackle, matching jersey 97 in the final gamebook.

EA SPORTS' official Madden NFL 27 player page identifies player ID 15223 as Las Vegas Raiders defensive tackle Tonka Hemingway with OVR 68, matching the frozen registry identity and calibrated 0.0 Walters value.
EA SPORTS' official Madden NFL 27 Week 3 player page identifies Corey Kiner, player ID 15039, as a New England halfback with OVR 67; the frozen non-QB calibration maps that OVR to 0.0 Walters points.

The postgame injury review reports that Charles Woods returned, Dre'Mont Jones did not return, and Cory Durden returned at the next possible opportunity. This is used only to interpret literal return status; no unsupported impairment or snap-time weighting is inferred.

The Patriots' published unofficial depth chart lists Dre'Mont Jones first and Gabe Jacas second at the same OLB position. The frozen registry values both players at 0.5, supporting an equal-value relief invariant rather than an injury loss.

The postgame snap review confirms Corey Kiner's increased role after Henderson left, Tanner Arkin's added fullback role, Caleb Lomu's left-tackle relief, Jones' early-fourth-quarter departure without return, and Jacas' heavy edge work. Snap counts corroborate role identity only and are not used as a time weight.
